headline: Mark Cuban Fires Back At AI Warning: ‘No Chance Radiologists Get Replaced’ (CORRECTED)
summary: Billionaire investor Mark Cuban on Wednesday pushed back against the idea that artificial intelligence could soon replace radiologists, arguing that medical professionals will remain essential even as AI becomes more deeply integrated into health care.
